name: Molly Maeve
source: The hard-working businesswoman, Molly, is Arthur's niece. Instead of developing her magical talents, she decided to open her own cafe in Cordale and make money for her chain of restaurants. Arthur disapproves of his niece's choice but has no way of influencing it.
